title: Optional audience measurement across the website
summary: Choose whether to share website visit and navigation statistics, with a compact preference panel.
body:
- Optional audience measurement now covers public pages and clicks towards the game, Discord and the shop.
- A compact panel lets you allow or decline Google Analytics cookies. Both choices keep the website, games and purchases available.
- Change your choice at any time from Analytics preferences in the footer. Existing visitors can choose again for this expanded scope.
- Our events exclude player names, linking codes, payment details and URL search parameters.
